fullContentHtml:
SSC Delhi Police Constable Executive PE & MT Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Staff Selection Commission, SSC has released the PE & MT Admit Card for the Delhi Police Constable (Executive) posts after evaluating candidates’ performance in the examination. This recruitment was conducted for 7,201 posts. Applications for the SSC Delhi Police Constable (Executive) Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 22 September 2025 to 31 October 2025. The PE & MT will be held from 18 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their SSC Delhi Police Constable Executive PE & MT Admit Card 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 September 2025
  • Last Date : 31 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 October 2025
  • Online Correction Date : Notify Later
  • Exam Date : 18 December 2025 to 06 January 2026
  • Self Slot Selection : 05 – 30 December 2025
  • Admit Card : 15 December 2025
  • Answer Key : 13 January 2026
  • Result : 19 June 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 07 June 2026
  • Marks : 07 June 2026
  • PE & MT Date : 19 August to 01 September 2026
  • New PE & MT Exam Start : 18 September 2026
  • PE & MT Admit Card : 08 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
